scope: Read-only local audit of actual copied TextCraft/native installed owner source and existing checkpoint100 dtype receipt. No SSH, privilege escalation, model construction, GPU test, production source/config edit, or new numerical tolerance.
method_specification: experiments/rl/PLAN.md; Q/V/A, observation mask and upstream PPO are unchanged.

runtime_identity.status_scope: Dated snapshot identity only; not a fresh live-process assertion. The stopped job is not restarted by this audit.

call_chain.finding: Applies FSDP2 to actor_module with CPUOffloadPolicy(pin_memory=True); _is_offload_param=False. Original sharder receives the actor and native full_params/load_format/layered_summon settings.
state_dict pre-save hook calls _to_sharded before parameter state is collected.
Default placement is Shard(0); actor local DTensor is a view of pinned CPU padded shard storage. _to_sharded restores this parameter object.
state_dict recursively collects param.detach(), a shallow storage-sharing state artifact; this stage is not the ownership isolation boundary.
get_peft_model_state_dict calls model.state_dict(), filters LoRA tensors and removes adapter names while retaining tensor values by reference.

Native collection materializes DTensors with full_tensor().detach().cpu(); the extra outer conversion handles DTensors returned through the PEFT wrapper branch. A fresh local params mapping is built for every __enter__; update_params forwards that mapping in a new TensorLoRARequest ID, then params is deleted. LoRA base_sync_done path returns before base model.load_weights. No persistent staged export dictionary is reused by this sharder.
full_tensor redistributes to Replicate then returns a view of the redistributed local tensor.
Recorded Shard(0) -> Replicate follows shard all-gather, not the same-placement storage-reuse shortcut.
Shard._to_replicate_tensor calls funcol.all_gather_tensor; optional unpadding is applied to the gathered result.

all_gather_tensor contract leaves the input unchanged and calls native all_gather_into_tensor. Registered Meta allocates input.new_empty with dimension zero multiplied by group size. The gather is the actor-to-payload isolation boundary according to the owner contract.

call_chain.owner: Actual pinned VERL tensor-backed LoRA transport
call_chain.finding: TensorLoRARequest carries the exact updated_params mapping. Hijacked _load_adapter passes lora_tensors to native from_lora_tensors(device='cpu', dtype=self.lora_config.lora_dtype).
from_lora_tensors uses tensor.to(device,dtype) and optional pin_memory. It can share storage with its already-gathered payload when these are no-ops; that does not reconnect it to the actor shard.

optimize folds scaling into B then sets scaling=1. PackedLoRALayerWeights.pack first optimizes each child and builds the packed object with scaling=1, so the manager's subsequent packed optimize does not scale B a second time.

First registration _add_adapter calls _create_merged_loras_inplace and optimize. Cache hits only touch and activate the existing LoRAModel. Activation calls set_lora, not optimize. Repeated activation therefore does not reapply alpha/r.
set_lora copies A/B into dedicated stacked slot tensors with copy_; it does not mutate the actor or fold scaling again.

conclusions.actor_storage_alias: The recorded world-size-2 Shard(0) export path isolates actor storage at native full_tensor all-gather. PEFT shallow references and no-op detach/cpu do not bypass that gather. No actor B storage alias defect is supported by this source path.
conclusions.payload_mutation: vLLM may fold alpha/r into its gathered export payload if from_lora_tensors retains that storage. Such payload-local mutation is expected owner behavior and is distinct from actor mutation.
conclusions.repeated_scaling: Fresh native collection/ID per sync, optimize->scaling=1, packed scaling=1, and cache activation without optimize do not implement a repeated alpha/r scaling loop. No repeated-scaling defect is supported for this recorded native path.
conclusions.production_action: No LoRA clone, alpha/r config change, transport replacement, or other production patch is justified by this audit.
conclusions.policy_collapse: This audit does not identify LoRA alias/repeated scaling as the cause of late TextCraft collapse and does not claim recovery. The separately demonstrated truncated terminal reward wiring defect remains the confirmed defect.

verification_scope: Actual copied source and source receipt hashes plus actual checkpoint100 dtype/placement evidence; no runtime actor/payload data_ptr witness, model log-prob comparison, training recovery, or new tensor-ownership test was performed or made into an acceptance requirement.
